Remark
[Uniform convergence of the heat evolution] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0399 ↗ prop:chow-iii-distance-like-function-bounded-derivatives 1. ch26:26.51\group Distance-like Functions

The heat evolution of the initial distance-like function converges uniformly to it as $t\downarrow 0$; this follows from the local estimate and the Gaussian tail bounds used in the proof.
